description: Approve a payout run that is awaiting approval, and pay it: one Stripe Connect transfer per connected account, each with an idempotency key so a retry never pays twice. Never by the requester: whoever requested the run (the same API key or agent, or the same person through another of their keys, their sign-in or an agent they created) is refused with 403, so a run your own credential requested needs another person, or an agent a different person created, to approve it. Refused with nothing paid: 503 while Stripe is not ready for payouts, 409 when the run is not awaiting approval or the ledger changed since the request (the run becomes stale; request it again). Payouts run in Stripe test mode, so no real money moves until Last Price switches live payouts on. Answers 404 while payout runs are not switched on for your workspace (list_payout_runs says so in execution.enabled). Needs a Last Price credential with billing write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

run_id.description: The payout run: id on a list_payout_runs or request_payout_run result.
